## Authority boundary

This review creates no provider selection, recommendation, contact, commercial outreach, contract acceptance, subscription, payment, credential, entitlement, trial, connection, external ingestion, publication, scanner, paper, pilot, capital, broker-order or live-trading authority.

## Exit sequence

1. Obtain qualified rights and permitted-use conclusions.
2. Obtain candidate entitlement schedules.
3. Review contracts, fees, attribution, audit and support terms.
4. Approve retention, deletion, privacy and redistribution controls.
5. Obtain accountable provider selection.
6. Obtain Sponsor authority before commercial contact.
7. Provision protected trial credentials outside the repository.
8. Execute PQA-01–PQA-18 on licensed samples.
9. Certify provenance, correction and quality mappings.
10. Accept WBS 1.2/5.2 and rerun the gate.
